{{Quote|I decided the only way we can break the blockade is if I pilot the ''Defender'' right into their battleship and take out their commander.''"<br />"''What?''"<br />"''This way, I'm the only one at risk. Besides, the ''Defender'' is damaged already.|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano|audio=DefenderDamagedAlready-SOR.flac|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
The '''''Defender''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] was seized by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], and a large Confederate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], under the command of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]], [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the world. The ''Defender'' was dispatched in a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] task force under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|eliminate]] the Confederate blockade.

Upon the arrival of the ''Defender'' and its fellow [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] and the [[Redeemer/Legends|''Redeemer'']], in the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]], Tuuk was able to lure the Republic forces into a trap. The Confederate captain's summoning of reinforcements forced the cruisers to retreat, but not before the ''Resolute'' and the ''Defender'' had sustained damage and the ''Redeemer'' was destroyed altogether. Regrouping, Skywalker devised a plan to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the heavily damaged ''Defender'' into Tuuk's [[Procurer|lead ship]], leaving Tano to command the ''Resolute'' and eliminate the remaining [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigates]] in the blockade. Skywalker and his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], piloted the ''Defender'' into the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and put it on course before fleeing in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], and the cruiser destroyed Tuuk's flagship when it collided with the bridge.

==Description==
At 1,137 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long,<ref name="Databank" /> the ''Defender'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]<ref name="Databank" /> that served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ''Defender'' had an armament of fifty-two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], eight [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|DBY-827 heavy dual turbolaser turrets]], two medium dual [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, four [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]] tubes, and six [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors.<ref name="Databank" /> The ''Defender'' had a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and was equipped with at least one [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. It also featured a pair of [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command towers]] and eight [[Engine/Legends|engines]], and was outfitted with [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

==History==
===First assault===
{{Quote|Our blockade is impenetrable. When the Republic attacks, they will get ''quite'' a surprise.|Captain Mar Tuuk, on his trap for Skywalker's task force|audio=OurBlockadeIsImpenetrable-SOR.flac|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 24: Toydaria" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] was invaded by [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the world's [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants were subjugated to a harsh rule. Tambor also [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the planet and placed [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]], a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], in charge of the Confederate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. In response, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] dispatched [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|breach]] the Confederate blockade and make way for Republic invasion forces&mdash;under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]&mdash;to land and liberate the planet. The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''Defender'', along with the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] and the [[Redeemer/Legends|''Redeemer'']], was assigned to Skywalker's task force, while [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] accompanied Skywalker and Tano aboard the ''Resolute''.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

[[File:Storm_Over_Ryloth.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Resolute'', ''Defender'', and ''Redeemer'' are heavily damaged in their first attempt at breaking the Confederate blockade.]]
When Skywalker's [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] arrived out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]], the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] immediately engaged the Confederate fleet. Tano led a [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|starfighter squadron]] on an attack run against Tuuk's [[Procurer|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] and the two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] flanking it. The three Republic Star Destroyers remained behind and provided heavy support fire. Tano's [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] managed to cut a path through the Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] to Tuuk's [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], but Tuuk summoned reinforcements in the form of four more ''Munificent''-class [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]]. The Confederate [[Starship/Legends|ships]] began to fire upon the Republic fleet, causing heavy damage to all three of the Star Destroyers.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

With the Republic fleet outgunned and outmaneuvered, Admiral Yularen ordered a full retreat from the [[Star system/Legends|system]], and called Tano and her squadron back to the ''Resolute'' to give fighter cover. However, Tano disobeyed orders, believing that she could reach Tuuk's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] and destroy it. Without Tano's assistance, the ''Defender'' and the other two Star Destroyers were heavily damaged by Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Death/Legends|suicide]] attacks. After losing most of her squadron, Tano returned to the Republic fleet, and the ''Defender'' and the ''Resolute'' were able to retreat to hyperspace. However, the ''Redeemer'' had taken heavy damage and broke apart in [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

===Second assault===
[[File:Tuuk_Skywalker.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker contacts Tuuk from the ''Defender''.]]
{{Quote|All cannons, fire! Fire!''"<br />"''We can't stop it. What should we do?|Captain Mar Tuuk and an [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid 1 (Ryloth blockade)/Legends|OOM command battle droid]], before the ''Defender'' rams into their ship|audio=AllCannonsFire-SOR.flac|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
The remainder of Skywalker's fleet retreated from the battlefield to consolidate their forces and treat the injured. The ''Defender'' itself had lost one of its command towers, and large fires had sprouted along its [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. After conferring with [[General/Legends|Generals]] Kenobi and Windu via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], Skywalker was given one planetary rotation to breach the blockade, even though only half of his original forces remained. General Skywalker devised a plan to evacuate the heavily damaged ''Defender'' and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the Star Destroyer with his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], into Tuuk's lead [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|ship]]. Skywalker and R2-D2 would escape the collision in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], while Tano&mdash;in command of the ''Resolute''&mdash;would engage and destroy the six remaining Confederate frigates.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

After the ''Defender''{{'s}} personnel were transferred to the ''Resolute'', Skywalker and R2-D2 piloted the ''Defender'' back to the system. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] opened a hololink to Captain Tuuk and lied to the Neimoidian, stating that he would surrender himself, his crew, and the ''Defender'' in exchange for the safe passage of food and [[Medpac/Legends|medical supplies]] to Ryloth. At first, Tuuk believed the Jedi's deception, but Skywalker's lie was uncovered when a complete scan of the ''Defender'' discovered that the Jedi was the only life-form aboard. Skywalker leveled the ''Defender'' at the control ship and gunned the cruiser's engines before he and R2-D2 made their way to an escape pod.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

[[File:Defender_Venator.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Defender'' rams Tuuk's flagship.]]
Tuuk's [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] opened fire at the ''Defender'', but could not stop the vessel or force it to change its course. When it became clear that his flagship would be destroyed, Captain Tuuk fled in an escape pod, leaving the droids in control of the remaining ships in the blockade. The ''Defender'' smashed into the center sphere of Tuuk's control ship, and the ''Resolute'' arrived out of hyperspace to engage what remained of the Confederate blockade. Tano's forces were able to defeat the frigates, and Generals Windu and Kenobi arrived with three [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] out of hyperspace, ready to land with the Republic invasion forces. Tano dispatched a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] to pick up General Skywalker's escape pod.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> The destruction of the Confederate blockade, due in part to the sacrifice of the ''Defender'', allowed Kenobi and Windu's ground forces to land on the planet<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> and eventually liberate Ryloth.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

==Commanders and crew==
During the first assault on the Confederate blockade over Ryloth, the ''Defender'' sustained heavy damage, and its remaining [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], supplies, and crew were later transferred to the ''Resolute'' for Skywalker's plan to pilot the cruiser into Tuuk's command ship. Skywalker assumed control of the ''Defender'' when he and R2-D2 took the Star Destroyer back to the Ryloth system.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Defender'' was first mentioned in the reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released on [[December 9]], [[2008]]. The Star Destroyer made its first appearance in "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>

An animation error in "Storm Over Ryloth" showed the ''Defender'' with both of its command towers intact, just moments after showing the ship with the starboard tower destroyed.
